caseNameFull: Helvering, Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. U.S. Refractories Corp.
attorneys: Mr. Erwin N. Griswold, with whom Solicitor General Biggs and Messrs. Sewall Key and J. P. Jackson were on the brief, for petitioner. Mr. W. W. Montgomery, Jr., with whom Mr. Robert P. Smith was on the brief, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Decree affirmed by an equally divided Court. Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
